Final Cut Pro exports used as test fixtures
============================================

Every .fcpxml file in this folder was written by Final Cut Pro itself
(10.7 and 11, so FCPXML 1.11 and 1.13; each carries Final Cut's uids,
modDate, library location and media bookmarks), published by the authors
below as test data under the MIT License, and copied here unchanged (one
renamed). tests/test_fcp_exports.py checks roughcut's FCPXML conventions
against them.

From orchetect/swift-fcpxml (https://github.com/orchetect/swift-fcpxml),
commit 00bcacf213cca9b99ced1efd3aad7529396719c7,
Tests/SwiftFCPXMLTests/TestResource/FCPXML Exports/:
    Complex.fcpxml, Annotations.fcpxml, AudioOnly.fcpxml, Occlusion3.fcpxml,
    24With25Media.fcpxml, SyncClip.fcpxml, TwoClipsMarkers.fcpxml

From TheAcharya/pipeline-neo, now OpenFCPXMLKit (https://github.com/TheAcharya/pipeline-neo),
commit 7f55583a3a5b4fecf336ca2ae4b77fb11f8db46d, Tests/FCPXML Samples/FCPXML/:
    TimelineWithSecondaryStorylineWithAudioKeyframes.fcpxml, ImageSample.fcpxml

From andrewarrow/cutlass (https://github.com/andrewarrow/cutlass),
commit 4dbe20dea4152b9de7d9c6ba8cf70e04bda9feb7, samples/:
    short.fcpxml, saved here as VerticalShort.fcpxml
